title: Kagamine Rin — A Reassuring Spell〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Everybody! Are you all having fun?!”

rows.Speaker: Len & KAITO
rows.Line: “Yeah...”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, you guys gotta sound more energetic than that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we never actually said we'd help with...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hush! I'm starting over!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She isn't going to let us go until we do what she wants, is she...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Looks like we have no choice...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Everybody! Are you all having fun?!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
“I can't hear you!
Say, 'Yay!'”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What are you all doing?
I could hear her shouting from down the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MC practice, apparently.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MC practice?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember how we all got to see Free Cluster play the other day?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It apparently reminded her of the importance of knowing how to interact with your audience.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, she wants to be able to connect with them in as many ways as she can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way, Len and KAITO are acting as members of the audience, while our job is to judge how she does.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case, I'll be a judge as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you took the easy job...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure I have no idea what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Miku-P!
How'd I do just now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought that was good. I was encouraged by the way you threw all your energy at us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case, we'll jump to the end of the show. The last time I talk before the finale!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, things feel much more sentimental now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think she's going to say?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
“Thank you all for coming today.
You guys helped make this the best show ever.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
“This arena really is huge.
Your faces all look so small compared to when we're playing at a live house.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Some of the others were talking about how they should look slimmer standing all the way up here. Oh, was I not supposed to tell them that? Sorry, my bad.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think she's been influenced by how Free Cluster interacted with the audience when they were still new.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, right... She did seem to think the jokes were the big takeaway from that video Ichika and the others showed us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But forget being influenced by them, she's practically doing impressions at this point...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Hey, why aren't you guys over there listening?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, she heard us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's really in character now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “But it doesn't matter that you're physically far away. We'll always have each other in our hearts...”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whew! How was that?!
Did I sound cool and mature?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you sounded cooler than usual.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it didn't really suit you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really? Why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what Len means.
Your audience will likely want to see you put your cheerful personality on full display, Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with wanting to sound more mature, but I think you'll be even more captivating just being yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Just being myself...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'll try being more fun and passionate for my next attempt!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That seems like a good plan.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, that means I have to start again from the top!

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, I have to basically rethink everything now, right? So, Len, KAITO, get back in character!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like we're going to be here for quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Everybody! Are you all having fun?!”
